description: This is a Kotlin source file implementing the DefaultNotesRepository class, which manages note data including CRUD operations, synchronization with remote API, and observing notes and sync status within a note organizer application.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages note data, handles CRUD operations, and performs synchronization with remote backend service.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a flow to observe the current sync status.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a flow of notes filtered by search query.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a flow observing a specific note by ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with given title and content, returns the generated ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted (tombstone) for synchronization.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Performs an immediate synchronization with remote backend, updating sync status accordingly.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Executes the synchronization process including uploading local changes, downloading remote updates, merging, and updating sync marker.
